summary: CAIR Action's 2024 guide described Lieber, then a county-supervisor candidate, as an outspoken supporter of ceasefire and Palestinian rights. It does not date the underlying statements.
quote: Sally Lieber has been an outspoken supporter of ceasefire and Palestinian rights.
date_note: Observed October 14, 2026 in the explicitly labeled 2024 guide, page 5. This is a historical guide assessment; dates of the underlying statements are unknown.
